summary: CFNEWS IMMO reports a transaction on the shares of the company holding Fouquet's Paris, 46 avenue George V, sold by the al-Tajir family's SCI 46. The buyer and price are behind a paywall and to be confirmed.
title: Shares of Fouquet's Paris property company change hands
why: Ownership of a newly distinguished Champs-Élysées palace is moving; confirm the buyer before publishing.
